positions.name: PallasineChecklistAuthority
positions.frame: how is the Pallasine checklist established as the current onboarding authority?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the legitimation of the Pallasine checklist as the operative onboarding process: src-1 states the universal mandate (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) as settled practice, while src-2 grounds that authority in a supersession of the old wiki page. The set holds a conviction gradient — src-1 performs a ratified decision, src-2 a historical claim — but both serve the same directional read of how the checklist came to govern.
